States Industries is a privately held American manufacturer specializing in premium hardwood plywood, custom wood veneer panels, prefinished panels, and specialty components. Founded in Eugene, Oregon, in 1966, the company serves woodworkers, architects, designers, cabinetmakers, furniture manufacturers, and commercial fabricators across North America. Its products include custom hardwood panels, ApplePlyÂ®, NOVA prefinished panels, wall paneling, and precision-manufactured components. States Industries emphasizes innovation, quality, and environmentally responsible manufacturing, offering customizable veneer species, cores, finishes, sizes, and performance specifications. The company operates its primary manufacturing facility in Eugene and also operates DrawerBox Specialties in Orange, California. States Industries currently employs more than 300 people. 
The company headquarters is located in 29545 Enid Road East, Eugene, OR 97402, United States. 201-500 Employees

aware.com zoominfo.com/c/aware-inc/6522832 400 GB Aware, Inc. (NASDAQ: AWRE, founded 1986, Burlington, MA) is the pioneering US biometrics software company — it helped the FBI set the WSQ fingerprint standard in 1993 and went public in 1996 — now selling identity verification and multi-modal biometric (face, fingerprint, iris, voice, palm) software to ~80 government agencies and hundreds of commercial customers worldwide. Its flagship Awareness Platform™ (launched 2025) is a SaaS "control plane" orchestrating biometric workflows, liveness detection (anti-deepfake/injection) and matching across multiple vendors, validated by top-tier tests: zero successful attacks in DHS RIVR Track 3, ISO/IEC 30107-3 Level 1–3 certification, NIST FATE and FIDO2. Since February 2025 the company has been led by CEO Ajay Amlani (co-founder of CLEAR, ex-DHS/IDEMIA), driving a pivot from a fragmented product portfolio to the platform — including a workforce reduction and a plan to cut opex by $4M/year.

Allied Machine & Engineering is a family-owned American manufacturer specializing in precision holemaking and finishing cutting tools for metalworking industries. Founded in 1941 and headquartered in Dover, Ohio, the company develops advanced tooling solutions for drilling, boring, reaming, threading, burnishing, porting, and other machining applications. Its product portfolio includes replaceable-insert and solid-carbide drills, boring systems, thread mills, PCD tools, reamers, and specialized tooling. Allied serves customers across aerospace, automotive, agriculture, heavy equipment, medical, oil and gas, renewable energy, structural steel, and defense industries. The company operates globally, with facilities and distribution capabilities in the United States, Europe, Germany, India, and other markets. 
The company headquarters is located in 485 W 3rd Street, Dover, OH 44622, United States. 201-500 Employees

wooshinsys.co.kr wooshinsys.com  finance.yahoo.com/quote/017370.KS/financials/ WOOSHIN SAFETY SYSTEMS CO LTD (KOSPI: 017370, founded 1984, Siheung/Seoul, South Korea) is a global car-body automation specialist — building robotic welding assembly lines for 40+ automakers (GM, Ford, Stellantis, Volvo, Hyundai/Kia, Rivian, Tata) — and the only company in the world that also builds EV battery module/pack assembly lines, giving it a unique edge as carmakers merge body and battery production. It also manufactures auto parts (body doors, seat belts via Wooshin Safety Systems, interiors), with seat-belt order backlogs around KRW 2 trillion (Ford F-150, GM Silverado EV, Stellantis Jeep Compass). Financials are cyclical: record 2024 revenue of KRW 563.6B (OP ₩36.1B) fell 31% to ₩388.6B in 2025 on fewer automation orders, and Q1–Q2 2026 posted operating losses as orders slipped — though analysts (Kiwoom BUY target ₩9,500, SK Securities ₩13,000) forecast a 2026–27 recovery to ~₩451–543B revenue.

Step By Step, Inc. is a private nonprofit human services organization established in 1977 and headquartered in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania. The organization provides community-based support services to individuals with intellectual and physical disabilities, autism, mental health disorders, and substance use disorders. Its services include residential programs, vocational and employment support, behavioral health and counseling, autism services, in-home and community support, and other individualized programs designed to promote independence and community participation. Step By Step serves more than 2,000 individuals across multiple regions and more than a dozen Pennsylvania counties. The organization works with individuals, families, and community partners to provide personalized support throughout different stages of life. 
The company headquarters is located in 744 Kidder Street, Wilkes-Barre, PA 18702, United States.
1K-5K Employees

zelham.com rocketreach.co/zelham-inc-profile_b580fe5ef66e1a3f Zelham, Inc. is a U.S. hospitality renovation general contractor headquartered in Boise, Idaho, founded in 2000 and owned since 2023 by President & CEO Stephen Horel. The company specializes in hotel remodeling, rebranding, and ADA conversions, with 500+ completed projects and licenses in 47 states. It employs approximately 55–57 people across 15 states, generating an estimated annual revenue of $9.6M–$41.6M (sources vary). Zelham works with 20+ major hotel brands (Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Sonesta, Four Seasons), offering pre-construction planning, free estimates, and turnkey project management.

santpau.cat zoominfo.com/c/hospital-de-la-santa-creu-i-sant-pau/372615247 Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau is a 625-year-old Barcelona medical institution (founded 1401) and a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1997. It combines a major academic hospital (2009) with the Recinte Modernista, a masterpiece of Catalan Modernism designed by Lluís Domènech i Montaner. The hospital employs ~4,965 people, runs on a ~€490M annual budget, and has 600 beds and 25 operating rooms, serving 400,000+ patients a year. Its research institute (IR Sant Pau, founded 1992) employs 1,632 staff with 1,058+ publications and 705 active clinical trials.

victims.description: rotamac.ca Rotamac Inc. is a privately held industrial equipment distributor founded in November 2019 and based in Rosemère/Montreal, Quebec, Canada (283 rue de Normandie, Rosemère, QC J7A 1T4). It is a micro company of 1–10 employees, essentially built around owner-founder Joey Desrosiers (HEC Montréal, 20+ years in compressed air and rotating equipment). Revenue is not publicly disclosed (small private company), but its e-commerce arm canadacompressorparts.com carries ~43,675 SKUs of non-OEM compressor parts (Atlas Copco, Ingersoll Rand, CompAir compatible) shipping across Canada. Core business: sales representation and distribution of pumps, air/gas compressors, vacuum pumps and nitrogen/oxygen generators, focused on lowering Total Cost of Ownership

mandurahses.org.au Mandurah State Emergency Service is a volunteer emergency rescue unit (part of DFES Western Australia), founded in 1976/78 and celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026, based at 31 Education Drive, Greenfields, WA 6210. It is a non-profit organization — there is no revenue; funding comes from DFES (WA Government) and community donations. The unit has ~80+ active volunteers and 60–90 cadets (ages 12–17), one of the largest SES cadet programs in WA (26 years running), led by Local Manager Chris Stickland ESM (volunteer since 1986, unit leader since 2010). It responds 24/7/365 to storms, floods, land searches, water/cliff rescues and fires support — logging ~3,500–4,300 operational hours and up to 8,000 community hours per year.

westropprimaryschool.co.uk Westrop Primary & Nursery School is a state-funded community school in Highworth, Swindon (Wiltshire, UK), founded in 1969, serving children aged 2–11. It currently has ~380 enrolled students (capacity 495), with 18.6% on free school meals and 16.3% on SEN support. The school employs ~47 staff (15 teachers + 32 teaching assistants, 20:1 student-teacher ratio) under Headteacher Cindy Acres (since 2018). Annual income is approximately £2 million (~£5,461 per pupil), with a healthy £75K surplus and ~£100K reserves. Rated "Good" by Ofsted (October 2022, maintained since 2012), though 2024/25 exam results showed weaker math progress and 0% at higher standards compared to strong 2018/19 performance. It runs 11 primary classes plus a three-room nursery and is known for its Forest School program and strong pupil premium support.

gerritystone.com zoominfo.com/c/gerrity-stone-inc/48615647 GerrityStone, Inc. is a family-owned stone fabrication and installation company founded in 1997 (part of the Gerrity family business dynasty dating back to 1906), based in Wilmington, Massachusetts, with a state-of-the-art 44,400 sq ft fabrication facility opened in 2022. It is a private, self-funded company with estimated annual revenue of ~$4.4M (range $1–10M) and 43–53 employees. GerrityStone operates the largest natural stone inventory in New England — 2,000+ slabs across 300+ colors, imported mainly from Italy and Brazil. The company offers full-cycle service (digital templating, CNC/water-jet fabrication, installation) and was the first new authorized Cambria quartz fabricator in 10 years. It has won "Best of Boston Home" multiple times (2009, 2010, 2024)
